technology_name: Remote Water and Wastewater Monitoring System (NIRCHHARI)
institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Need for remote monitoring of water and wastewater infrastructure
description: NIRCHHARI is an ultrasonic sensor-based monitoring system for water and wastewater assets such as rivers, channels, tanks, and sewers. The system measures conditions remotely and communicates data for infrastructure monitoring and alert generation.
applications:
Water supply and wastewater management utilities
Smart city and urban infrastructure monitoring projects
Municipal corporations and local government bodies
Environmental monitoring and water resource management agencies
IoT solution providers and industrial automation companies developing remote monitoring systems
secondary_sector: Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Water, Environment & Waste Management
